subject: Social Media
title: What Is a Parasocial Bond
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is a Parasocial Bond.

hook.text: You know their dog's name, their coffee order, their breakup. They don't know you exist.

buildup.text: Horton and Wohl named this in 1956: parasocial interaction—a one-sided relationship with a media figure.

discovery.text: Social media intensified it. Influencers share daily updates, creating an illusion of genuine friendship.

twist.text: Your brain can't tell the difference. The same oxytocin that bonds real friends activates for influencers.

climax.text: When an influencer 'betrays' trust—a scandal, a sell-out—fans feel genuinely heartbroken.

punchline.text: The friendship is real to you. Only to you.

quiz.question: What is a parasocial relationship?
options: A one-sided bond with a media figure
